run_ml_train_co2r: run ML model training on CO2R experimental data with random forest and linear regression
run_ml_train_her: run ML model training on HER experimental data to predict voltage vs SHE
run_ml_train_with_processed_df: run ML training using a preprocessed CSV dataframe instead of raw experimental and computational files
run_ml_train_with_el_features: run ML training with Matminer elemental features added to the feature set
run_ml_train_loo_cv: run ML training using leave-one-out cross-validation for model evaluation
